title.ko: 강한 연어: make/take/give/have + 명사, 형용사-명사 짝 · bitter disappointment · heated debate · wholeheartedly agree
title.en: strong collocations: make/take/give/have + noun, adjective–noun pairs, bitter disappointment, heated debate, wholeheartedly agree

explain.ko: 연어(collocation)는 단어가 자연스럽게 함께 쓰이는 짝입니다. 강한 연어는 특정 형용사가 특정 명사와만 어울립니다: bitter disappointment, heated debate, sheer luck, fierce competition. 또한 make, take, give, have, reach 같은 기능 동사는 명사에 따라 짝이 정해집니다: reach a decision, make a mistake, take a risk, give an answer. 모국어의 직역은 어색해질 수 있으므로 덩어리째 익히세요.
explain.en: Collocations are pairs of words that naturally go together. Strong collocations pair certain adjectives only with certain nouns: bitter disappointment, heated debate, sheer luck, fierce competition. Delexical verbs such as make, take, give, have and reach also pair with particular nouns: reach a decision, make a mistake, take a risk, give an answer. Literal translation from your first language can sound odd, so learn them as chunks.

notes.en: Memorise collocations as chunks, not single words.

notes.ko: make와 do는 명사에 따라 다르게 짝지어집니다. (make a mistake, do research)
notes.en: Make and do pair with different nouns (make a mistake, do research).

notes.ko: 직역하면 어색한 경우가 많으니 사전과 코퍼스로 확인하세요.
notes.en: Literal translation often sounds odd; check a dictionary or corpus.

lines.t: Fluent English comes from pairing words naturally. For example, a heated debate is a heated debate, and making a decision is reach a decision. Pairings that do not match sound awkward even if they are grammatical.

trans.ko: 유창한 영어는 단어를 자연스럽게 짝지어 쓰는 데서 나옵니다. 예를 들어 열띤 논쟁은 heated debate이고, 결정을 내리다는 reach a decision입니다. 짝이 맞지 않는 표현은 문법적으로 옳아도 어색하게 들립니다.

prompt.ko: 강한 연어(bitter disappointment, heated debate, reach a decision 등)를 사용해 한 사건을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences about an event using strong collocations (bitter disappointment, heated debate, reach a decision, etc.).

task.model: A heated debate broke out over the budget. Opinions were divided at first, but the committee eventually reached a decision. I wholeheartedly agreed with that decision. As a result, bitter disappointment was avoided.

model_trans.ko: 예산을 두고 열띤 논쟁이 벌어졌어요. 처음에는 의견이 갈렸지만 위원회는 결국 결정을 내렸어요. 저는 그 결정에 진심으로 동의했어요. 결과적으로 쓰라린 실망은 피할 수 있었어요.
model_trans.en: A heated debate broke out over the budget. Opinions were divided at first, but the committee eventually reached a decision. I wholeheartedly agreed with that decision. As a result, bitter disappointment was avoided.
